title: Traction Heroes (Harry Max + Jorge Arango) open 'Agency' by reading Incorruptible — 'my 2026 book of the year'
summary: Harry Max (author of Managing Priorities) opens the Traction Heroes episode 'Agency' by reading from Incorruptible's 'Who is the Bank?' section, calling out Ries's diagnosis of financial gravity and the Whole Foods-to-Amazon arc as the frame for the whole conversation about organizational agency.
blockquote: I'm easily going to guess this is going to be my 2026 book of the year.
attribution_title: Co-host, Traction Heroes; author, Managing Priorities
